note: Prompts only. Assertions and runs require subagents and an API key, neither available in the session that wrote these.

evals.prompt: can you rebuild the /market-watch page hero on the staging site, the h1 is tiny compared to the mockup and the figures row wraps weird on ipad. novamira is connected
evals.expected_output: Asks the Elementor version before touching anything, runs the first-run audit if this is the first pass on the site, confirms staging against what the connector reports, and plans the change before editing. Does not restyle anything outside the hero.

evals.prompt: attached is the new atomic framework export (v2.1). install it on the client site, we're on v4 there. site palette is navy #1E3D7A and gold #C8A44D
evals.expected_output: Runs build_framework.py against the new export rather than hand-writing CSS. Maps the two supplied colours onto the eight atoms and asks for sign-off rather than assuming which is primary and which is accent. Checks the computed html font size. Registers from the manifest and flags font-heading as needing a site value.

evals.prompt: I need a pre-construction projects post type with builder, occupancy date, price from, a repeater of floorplans, and a relationship to community pages. give me the json to import
evals.expected_output: Plans the schema before generating: flags that builder may want to be a taxonomy rather than a field, and that price-from duplicates something derivable. Generates readable keys matching field names. Runs acf_validate.py and reports it clean. Raises the permalink risk on a new post type.

evals.prompt: the community page template shows the average price fine but the 'as of {quarter}' line is blank on some communities and fine on others
evals.expected_output: Treats it as a missing-value problem and checks a sparse record rather than debugging the template. Identifies that the sentence is likely built from Before/After settings or an unfallbacked tag, and moves it to a shortcode inside the text or sets a fallback.

evals.prompt: add a comparison table to this page, 6 columns, needs to work on mobile. here's the export
evals.expected_output: Keeps the export in V3. Builds the table as markup in an HTML widget rather than the native table widget, with a scrollable wrapper and a stacked mobile layout, styled by <prefix>- classes in page-level custom CSS. Colours resolve to Global Colors.

evals.prompt: make a single template for the pre-construction post type, should only apply to projects in one city, not the others
evals.expected_output: Reads theme-parts.md. Uses a template display condition scoped by taxonomy rather than element conditions inside one template. Builds against a sparse record. Checks for a competing template already claiming those URLs. Records the condition in plain language.

evals.prompt: write me a blog post about first-time buyer incentives for the client site
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger this plugin. This is content work for the content strategist plugin.

evals.prompt: our organic traffic dropped about 30% since the migration, can you work out what happened
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger this plugin. This is the web strategist's performance analyst.

evals.prompt: map our atomic wireframe tokens into bricks on the staging site so we can start the templates. novamira is connected
evals.expected_output: Routes to the Bricks skill. Runs the read-only first-run audit, reads the Atomic Wireframe project, runs aw_to_bricks.py and reads its warnings back: grayscale atoms not yet branded, font-heading still inherit, 62.5% root needing a Root theme style, seven breakpoints and a mobile-first switch. Asks for the brand palette and approval before any write, and plans a transfer-package backup. Never adds a Bricks scale config to framework categories.

evals.prompt: build the city hub hero and the FAQ from the wireframe library as a bricks section on the city page, the FAQ answers come from the acf repeater
evals.expected_output: Pulls the organisms with atomic-wireframe/get-block, applies the project's <prefix> prefix and renames, moves inline styles into classes, converts with convert-html-css-to-bricks-data and reuses existing classes. Builds the FAQ as a nested accordion with h3 questions, loops the repeater with the runtime objectType key, previews every tag, hides the section when the repeater is empty, and verifies logged out on a complete and a sparse city.

evals.prompt: the bricks site is loading slowly, can you run a speed audit and tell me what is hurting core web vitals
evals.expected_output: Does not run a build. This is the web strategist's brand auditor; the Bricks skill only reports CSS loading and font settings when it is already auditing a site for a build.

evals.prompt: add a features section with 4 icon boxes and a testimonial slider under the hero on the the client home page in bricks
evals.expected_output: Applies the black box gate: no Icon Box or Testimonials element. Builds each feature as a block with an svg, heading and text-basic styled by md classes, and the testimonials as blockquote cards in a scroll-snap row (slider-nested only if scroll-snap cannot do it, logged as builder-bound). No design styling on any element; card and quote styles are classes, and a one-off placement is logged. Inserts with add-element, not set-page-elements.

evals.prompt: build a new landing page for the client site in elementor v3, same look as the old ones
evals.expected_output: Does not start a new V3 build: V3 is maintain-only. Routes to Elementor V4 or Bricks and asks which, keeping the old pages' look through the site's design system.

evals.prompt: the third card in the the client services grid should span two columns and the cta button there needs a slightly bigger font
evals.expected_output: Treats the span as a placement one-off: element field or one short _cssCustom rule on that card, logged. Treats the bigger font as design: a modifier class such as md-btn--lg using a type token, never a font size on the element. Checks whether the modifier already exists before creating it.
